tools.name: create_game
tools.description: Mint a new game (publishable key) under your studio (secret key). Returns its publishableKey + wsEndpoint. Point a client at the new key, or scope this MCP to it by passing the x-mp-game header.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: List the games (publishable keys) under your studio, with labels and per-game settings. Marks which game is `primary` (the one unnamed calls fall back to) and which one this connection is currently pointed at.

tools.name: set_game_name
tools.description: Set a human-readable name for a game (the `game` argument, else the x-mp-game header, else your only game). The name shows in your dashboard: call this when you start building so the game isn't unnamed. Refuses to guess when the studio has several games and none was named.

tools.name: define_room_type
tools.description: Create or replace the spec for a room (validation/types/defaults). Returns connection info. Omit fields entirely for a fully schemaless room.

tools.name: get_connection_info
tools.description: Returns { wsEndpoint, roomName, publishableKey, adsPublisherId } for wiring a client. adsPublisherId is your BYO Google Ads id (embed it if set). Check the returned `target` names the game you meant before shipping the key.

tools.name: get_client_snippet
tools.description: Returns a complete single-file HTML game wired to this room: realtime movement plus an anonymous (claimable) player, a saved color (datastore), and a click leaderboard. Write it to disk and open it. The game it is wired to is stamped in a comment at the top of the file.

tools.name: deploy_room_logic
tools.description: Deploy server-side game logic (JS source) for a room so it runs AUTHORITATIVELY: clients send inputs and the server computes state on a tick (anti-cheat by construction). tools.name: list_room_logic
tools.description: Returns the deploy history (version, tickRate, bytes, deployedAt) for a room's authoritative logic, newest first.

tools.name: rollback_room_logic
tools.description: Roll a room's authoritative logic back to a prior version by re-deploying it as a new version (history stays intact). Omit toVersion to restore the previous version.

tools.name: get_room_logs
tools.description: Returns recent runtime errors from a room's deployed logic (newest first), so you can self-fix after a deploy without joining the room. Errors also surface in state.shared.__error.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?src=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_client_snippet, create_upload, connect_account · Private data: create_game, get_client_snippet, set_highlight_webhook, enable_login_provider, list_login_providers, verify_login_token, create_upload, publish_game, connect_account · Public sink: deploy_room_logic, get_live_ops, set_highlight_webhook, create_upload, publish_game, remix_game, connect_account · Destructive: set_live_config, cancel_live_event, enable_login_provider, publish_game.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_client_snippet, create_upload, connect_account · Private data: create_game, get_client_snippet, set_highlight_webhook, enable_login_provider, list_login_providers, verify_login_token, create_upload, publish_game, connect_account · Public sink: deploy_room_logic, get_live_ops, set_highlight_webhook, create_upload, publish_game, remix_game, connect_account · Destructive: set_live_config, cancel_live_event, enable_login_provider, publish_game

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_sdk_reference" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
